rows.note: Use this for the viewing surface in a cinema or movie presentation; it is the default rendering for this sense.

example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ngan4 mok6 leng3 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for inspecting people, baggage, or objects for something hidden.

example.english: The security guard needs to screen my bag for dangerous items.
example.traditional: 保安要檢查我個袋，睇下有冇危險品。
example.jyutping: bou2 on1 jiu3 gim2 caa4 ngo5 go3 doi6 tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 ngai4 him2 ban2

rows.note: Use this when a film, programme, or report is shown on television or another screen.

example.english: The television will screen this documentary tonight.
example.traditional: 電視今晚會播放呢套紀錄片。
example.jyutping: din6 si6 gam1 maan5 wui5 bo3 fong3 ni1 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2

rows.note: Use this in medical or genetic contexts for searching samples for a disease, drug, or other target.

example.english: The lab will screen these samples first.
example.traditional: 實驗室會先篩查呢批樣本。
example.jyutping: sat6 jim6 sat1 wui5 sin1 sai1 caa4 ni1 pai1 joeng6 bun2

rows.note: Use this for an insect-proof mesh screen fitted to a window, doorway, or sleeping area.

example.english: The room has a mosquito screen, so we can keep the window open without worrying about mosquitoes coming in.
example.traditional: 間房裝咗蚊網，開窗都唔怕蚊入嚟。
example.jyutping: gaan1 fong2 zong1 zo2 man1 mong5 hoi1 coeng1 dou1 m4 paa3 man1 jap6 lei4

rows.note: Use this specifically for medical or laboratory screening to detect a disease or condition.

example.english: The doctor arranged to screen me for cancer.
example.traditional: 醫生安排我做篩查，睇吓有冇癌症。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 on1 paai4 ngo5 zou6 sai1 caa4 tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 ngaam4 zing3

rows.note: Use this for a physical barrier or protective screen that blocks sight or shields against danger.

example.english: This barrier acts as a screen against flying rocks.
example.traditional: 呢幅屏障可以擋住飛嚟嘅碎石。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 ping4 zoeng3 ho2 ji5 dong2 zyu6 fei1 lei4 ge3 seoi3 sek6

rows.note: Use this for passing food or another material through a sieve to remove unwanted particles.

example.english: We screen the flour to remove the coarse bits.
example.traditional: 我哋用篩篩麵粉，隔走啲粗粒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 sai1 sai1 min6 fan2 gaak3 zau2 di1 cou1 nap1
